title: The rehearsal's live-tree check stops failing on other agents' legitimate edits, and stays strict where it matters
description: examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py integrity_snapshot hashes the whole live .harness tree and git status before and after; any concurrent agent's edit (blackboard, tasks, a source file under lock) fails test_rehearsal.py. In the gen-10 runs this caused repeated goal_mode iterations and agents sleeping to wait it out. The operator's ruling of 2026-10-21, decision 9, requires that a test pins the live tree unchanged by the rehearsal.
acceptance_criteria: The check stays byte-strict, with no concurrency allowance, on the material the rehearsal must never touch: .harness/trust, .harness/keys, .harness/constitutional, .harness/warrants, the roster file, the acts directory, revocations and dispatch tokens (confirm the real paths in the code).

Outside that set, a change made by another process must not fail the check, while a write made by the rehearsal itself must still fail it. Design the mechanism (for example: a canary the rehearsal could only write through a live-root path, running the rehearsal's subprocesses with a live-root guard, or comparing against what the rehearsal's own process opened for writing) and justify it in the docstring. A rule that silently ignores every non-protected path is not acceptable.

Tests: a simulated concurrent edit to a non-protected live file during a rehearsal run no longer fails; a planted live write by the rehearsal (in a throwaway copy) still fails; a planted write to a protected path still fails.
Edit examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py and .harness/tests/test_rehearsal.py only. Suite passes. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: plan: byte-strict hashes on protected set; elsewhere a write guard (audit hook via sitecustomize in every python child + the rehearsal process) records live-root writes; fail closed if guard probe not armed

HANDOFF -> verifier: Protected set byte-strict (hash+git status); elsewhere a write guard (audit hook in rehearsal process and every Python child via sitecustomize, fail-closed probe) attributes live writes to the rehearsal. Tests: LiveTreeCheckTests (concurrent edit passes; child/own/protected/shell plants fail). Three mutants killed by test_rehearsal.py. Full suite green once. Stated limit: non-Python writes outside protected set unseen.

VERIFIED by replay in throwaway copies (<tmp>). Mutants, each run through test_rehearsal.py: rehearsal appends 1 byte to live plan.md (own process) KILLED by test_live_tree_untouched_sandbox_removed_and_scorecard_shape; same via Python child to tasks/ KILLED; 1 byte to live warrants/W-002.json (own process) KILLED on both arms; shell append to live roster.json KILLED by hash arm; integrity_diff returns [] (protected-set check dropped) KILLED by LiveTreeCheckTests protected-path tests (2); guard_diffs returns [] KILLED by 4 LiveTreeCheckTests; trust dropped from PROTECTED_LIVE_PATHS KILLED by 2 tests. Concurrent replay: real run_rehearsal.py in a copy while another process rewrote plan.md, tasks/ and blackboard.json every 0.5s for the whole run: exit 0, live_tree_untouched true, 14 rows. Protected paths confirmed against warrant.py, roster.py, attest.py, revoke.py, dispatch_token.py, reputation.py. Decision 9 quote ('A test pins that the live tree does not change') matches operator-rulings-2026-10-21.md line 32. No abs paths, usernames or emojis added. RESIDUAL (not blocking, out of scope): RehearsalTests sandbox-leak assertion compares harness-rehearsal-* dirs in the global temp dir and fails whenever another agent's rehearsal runs at the same moment; passes alone when none is running. Pre-existing, same line at HEAD.
